title: In JetBrains Datalore before 2026.4 improper authorisation allowed notebook viewers to modify files (CVE-2026-123289)
description: JetBrains Datalore versions before 2026.4 contain an improper authorization vulnerability that allows users with notebook viewer permissions to modify files. This flaw could lead to unauthorized integrity impact without affecting confidentiality. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.4.
